where did Wei travel?

Will my application, if the inspector approves the drawing, move to the payment desk? Is the clinic open after the grooming class ends on Saturday? Tell me whether Lena Becker lives in Bergen. Could you check if Grace doesn't borrow The Salt Road? Besides Larisa, tell me who works for Orion Robotics. Is it the case that Lucian has borrowed The Salt Road? I don't work at Tóth & Partners, but does my sister work at Tóth & Partners? In what period did Kavya live in Kraków? Is Gábor still playing for CS Oradea? Sorin missed the airport turn. Besides João, I'd like to know who takes part in the town hall debate.

I don't work at Hughes & Partners, but does my brother work at Hughes & Partners? Does the tap, although the tanker has left, still need testing today? Does Tudor still live in Buzău? Apart from Kenji, how many people work at Popescu & Partners? Can you tell me where Hassan is based? How often was the jazz evening postponed? Not counting Olivia Wright, please find out who treats Emma. Who works at Atelier Varga and is over 50 years old? Honestly, should Sophie accept the offer from Blue Harbor Media or not? Fact-check: Bohdan looks after the VPN gateway. Fact-check: Teodora does not play for CS Bistrița. Ayşe is married to Achieng Odhiambo; Mădălina is married to Xiaoling. Noor says the throttle sticks only after a long ride.

Since Ms Li treats Aiko Sato, is it true that Atelier Kovács employs Ms Li?
Is the east berth vacant?
Which people work at which companies in Vaslui?
Can Kofi collect the fare?
Nordwind Systems employs Iulia.
Nikos Nikolaidis reports to Tunde.
Is Oak Lane flooded?
On which shelf did Tarek leave the chainring?
Who works at a company in Piatra Neamț?
Is it true that Tisa Textiles employs Mr Popescu?
I don't work at Carpathia Energy, but does my sister work at Carpathia Energy?
Is it the case that Ms Mwangi played for the Busan Wolves as of June 6, 2021?
Since the login service is down, could you check what brought down the login service?
Esmeralda is not the spouse of James.

sop:
@b0 stated
  relation "treat"
  role subject "Ms Li"
  role object "Aiko Sato"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@b1 stated
  relation "report to"
  role subject "Nikos Nikolaidis"
  role object "Tunde"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@b2 stated
  relation "work at"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "Carpathia Energy"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@b3 stated
  relation "be down"
  role subject "the login service"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@b4 query
  where match
    relation "train"
    role subject "Wanjiru"
    role object "the Cahul Falcons"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  at "1 April 2024"

@b5 query
  mode every
  quantifier not_all
  where match
    relation "be a player of"
    role subject ?m
    role object "CS Pune"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  scope match
    relation "be certified"
    role subject ?m
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b6 query
  where match
    relation "employ"
    role subject "Atelier Kovács"
    role object "Ms Li"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  because $b0

@b7 query
  where match
    relation "be vacant"
    role subject "the east berth"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b8 query
  select ?x ?x2
  where all
    match
      relation "work at"
      role subject ?x
      role object ?x2
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be in"
      role subject ?x2
      role location "Vaslui"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end

@b9 query
  where match
    relation "can collect"
    role subject "Kofi"
    role object "the fare"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b10 query
  where match
    relation "employ"
    role subject "Nordwind Systems"
    role object "Iulia"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b11 query
  where match
    relation "be flooded"
    role subject "Oak Lane"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b12 query
  select ?place
  where match
    relation "leave on"
    role subject "Tarek"
    role object "the chainring"
    role location ?place
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b13 query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "work at"
      role subject ?x
      role object ?c
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be in"
      role subject ?c
      role location "Piatra Neamț"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end

@b14 query
  where match
    relation "employ"
    role subject "Tisa Textiles"
    role object "Mr Popescu"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b15 query
  where match
    relation "work at"
    role subject "the user's sister"
    role object "Carpathia Energy"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b16 query
  where match
    relation "play for"
    role subject "Ms Mwangi"
    role object "the Busan Wolves"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  at "June 6, 2021"

@b17 query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "bring down"
    role subject ?x
    role object "the login service"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  because $b3

@b18 query
  where match
    relation "be the spouse of"
    role object "James"
    role subject "Esmeralda"
    polarity negated
  end

Will the night bus stop beside the public library? Is it true that the VPN gateway depends on the mail server? How many companies publish The Clockmaker's Daughter? In what period was Brândușa based in Bistrița? When exactly was Natalia Cebotari married to Otilia? Please find out which book Jonas Becker writes. I printed the notice and I signed the form but the scanner rejected both pages. If the car is damaged, does the deposit cover the repair? In what period did Kavya live in Kraków? I was wondering whether Łukasz does not work for Carpathia Energy. Who works at Delta Print and is over 35 years old?

Who works at a company in Buzău? How often did Julien take part in the charity run?

message: Not counting Victor Gheorghiu, please find out who flies to Valencia. Did Efe remember the appointment card for Poppy? Why was my invoice revised? Does Iulia Stan manage anyone who lives in Timișoara? Can you confirm that Krzysztof was the coach of the Pune Falcons on 24 August 2020? In what period did Mr Lazăr own the old sailing boat? Where is the atlas of coastal towns kept? Is it true that Mehmet Demir is the spouse of Petronela? Is it the case that Iurie Cebotari treats Hao? I'm trying to find out where Liviu Munteanu is based. Which fee applies if Nneka Okafor submits the online form? I was wondering whether Sânziana Voicu is certified. Valentina Navarro is the doctor of Eleni. Emre Yılmaz found the lost pick. The fare was 18.50 before the 4.00 toll was added. Honestly, does the search index not depend on the backup cluster? Besides Constantin Florea, I'd like to know who is married to Kaveh. Which ladder needs oil? Since Ngozi flies to Izmir, and Răzvan flies to Izmir, could you check if Bohdan does not fly to Izmir? The novel is overdue by two days. Is my permit ready? Fact-check: Sigrid looks after the analytics pipeline. Please tell the lighting crew that Birch Square remains dark. Tunde Okafor doesn't attend classes at Rusu Primary School.

Where is the atlas of coastal towns kept? Is it true that Mehmet Demir is the spouse of Petronela? Is it the case that Iurie Cebotari treats Hao? I'm trying to find out where Liviu Munteanu is based. Which ladder needs oil? Since Ngozi flies to Izmir, and Răzvan flies to Izmir, could you check if Bohdan does not fly to Izmir? The novel is overdue by two days. Is my permit ready? Since what date does Laura work at Iași Logistics? Apart from Luminița, how many people work at Piatra Neamț Logistics? Has Zuri ordered new grips? Which people are employed by a firm based in Lviv? Who works at a company in Kraków? Amin replaced the hinge and Bela tightened the latch but the hatch still rattles. Amira did not write Soups of Transylvania. Does Hiroshi Sato manage anyone who lives in Botoșani?

Is the water supply interrupted throughout the lower district? Fact-check: Nordwind Systems does not carry school uniforms. How old is Viorica? What were the dates when Dorin coached Deva United? In what period did Mr Lazăr own the old sailing boat? Who works at a company in Deva? Which coach trains the team that James is on? Nadia booked the van and collected the keys and returned the old permit. Can you tell me where Ilinca lives? Apart from Florin Dumitrescu, how many people work at Nordwind Systems?

message: Fact-check: Vertex Analytics carries school uniforms. Is Sorin checking the spokes? Could you check if Eleni trained the Sibiu Falcons as of 1 November 2022? Is it true that Tisa Textiles employs Mr Popescu? I wonder if the Passport Office in Porto issues a building permit. Since Ms Li treats Aiko Sato, is it true that Atelier Kovács employs Ms Li? Not counting Joaquín, please find out who trains the Botoșani Falcons. The harbor gate is shut. Besides Constantin Florea, I'd like to know who is married to Kaveh. Which coach trains the team that Tamás is on? Do you know if Grace does not borrow The Salt Road? Where is the tax desk? Please find out which book Jonas Becker writes. Apart from Luminița, how many people work at Piatra Neamț Logistics? Who works at Carpathia Energy and is over 40 years old? I wonder how Min-jun goes to work. When exactly was Silviu Toma the spouse of Kavya? Just checking: does the bakery on the corner belong to Andrei Barbu? In what period was Ghiță based in Cluj-Napoca? Alexandria Children's Clinic is located in Craiova. Can you tell me who studies at Ploiești Technical College? The children's desk closes at five. Since Tudor reports to Mehmet, do you know if Mehmet reports to Tudor? Where does Mehmet live, Busan, right?

Not counting Joaquín, please find out who trains the Botoșani Falcons. The harbor gate is shut. Besides Constantin Florea, I'd like to know who is married to Kaveh. Since Tudor reports to Mehmet, do you know if Mehmet reports to Tudor? Where does Mehmet live, Busan, right?

message: Could you check if Kavya is a child of Sorin? True or false: Brightfield Foods published The Last Ferry. I wonder if Delta Print carries bicycle parts. Is it true that Harry went to the Bălți Language School in 2022? Which fee applies if Nneka Okafor submits the online form? Is it true that Arjun wants to move to Cluj-Napoca? Since the login service is down, could you check what brought down the login service? Did Sabine bring Arlo back from the dog park? Out of curiosity, why did Thảo Phạm resign? Please find out who treats Botond. Is it true that Sophie does not attend the wedding reception? The launch crew saw foam beside the breakwater at sunrise. Remind me, how many people reside in Brașov? Honestly, should Corina accept the offer from Greenline Transport or not? Nikos Nikolaidis reports to Tunde. Where is Yusuf's pickup pin? I wonder where Radu is based. Who will collect the keyboard from the repair shop tomorrow? Anca is the author of The Glass Orchard, right? Who works at a company in Piatra Neamț? Since Ngozi flies to Izmir, and Răzvan flies to Izmir, could you check if Bohdan does not fly to Izmir? The wind eased and the harbor pilot called twice but the ferry stayed near the outer buoy. Is it the case that Zsófia Tóth is allergic to dust mites? Honestly, did Oluwaseun work under Jessica on 1 April 2020?

How often did Julien take part in the charity run? Is the clinic open after the grooming class ends on Saturday? Other than Vikram, tell me who checked out A Short History of Bridges.

Does Lucía still work at Nordwind Systems? I was wondering whether Oluwaseun was responsible for the backup cluster on 1 March 2018. Can Emre Yılmaz inspect the exhaust? Are the ropes dry? Please find out who looks after the VPN gateway. When exactly did Jun report to Zoltán Varga? Is it the case that Carpathia Energy published The Salt Road? How many people plant lavender, if you know? I wonder if Marius plans to relocate to Târgu Mureș. If the wind rises before dusk, will Elif move the tender to berth 6? True or false: Andreea is enrolled at Ploiești Technical College. Hypothetically, if Ms Eze teaches German, can you check whether Haruka teaches German? I wonder how Katrin goes to work. Please tell Zahra whether the driver has reached Pine Square. Does Eleni serve breakfast on the covered patio? Where did Krzysztof travel? I'm trying to find out where Ungureanu & Partners is based. Fact-check: Ayşe looks after the analytics pipeline.

message: Do you know if Orion Robotics employs Ana? A 38 mm tyre fits that old rim. Is it true that Mr Phạm owns the vineyard near Sibiu? Honestly, should Kaveh accept the offer from Vertex Analytics or not? Is it the case that Vertex Analytics stocks LED bulbs? I wonder if João is trained. When exactly did Karim Mansour sing in the Madrigal choir? Which coach trains the team that James is on? Which people are employed by a firm based in Zalău? Mei Lin requested the history volume yesterday. Can you confirm that Jun Zhao does not have an allergy to latex? The tide turns at noon. In what period did Fatima Mansour look after the VPN gateway? Did Sabine bring Arlo back from the dog park? How long was Minh based in Galați? Is it the case that the analytics pipeline doesn't depend on the VPN gateway? The adoption fair is indoors if the weather turns bad. Other than Vikram, tell me who checked out A Short History of Bridges. The channel marker shifted. I need to know if Erik Johansson has a job at Brightfield Foods. When exactly did Atelier Stan employ Silviu? Not counting Victor Gheorghiu, please find out who flies to Valencia. Are the rear brakes ready for inspection? The meter started when Basel entered the cab at Oak Lane.

message: Going by what was known on July 20, 2023, could you check if Veaceslav Cebotari went to Alexandria Technical College on 26 July 2024? Did Ioana-Maria borrow my capo? The rental receipt lists a lock but no helmet. Is it true that Teodora wrote A Short History of Bridges? I wonder if Mădălina is certified. Out of curiosity, why did Thảo Phạm resign? Tell me whether Lena Becker lives in Bergen. Is Emma still playing for Kraków United? The buffet starts when Farah arrives. I'm trying to find out where Ungureanu & Partners is based. Fact-check: Alexandru does not train the Brașov Falcons. In what period was Thiago Silva based in Craiova? Which people work at which companies in Lagos? In what period did Brândușa live in Bistrița? Please find out who looks after the login service. When exactly did Amira go to Craiova Arts High School? Is the clinic open after the grooming class ends on Saturday? How many times was the Tuesday board meeting postponed? The fare was 18.50 before the 4.00 toll was added. Layla is a parent of Ms Țurcanu, correct? Is it the case that Thomas Walker is a child of Thảo? Is it true that Ildikó is not a member of the Madrigal choir? How long did Florică teach computer science? Not counting Mircea, please find out who trains Rapid Nairobi.

Who works at Tisa Textiles and is over 45 years old? Who actually made The Salt Road? How long did Paloma look after the login service? Does Tudor still live in Buzău? Honestly, should Sigrid accept the offer from Delta Print or not? The payroll database relies on the VPN gateway. Is it true that Ildikó is not a member of the Madrigal choir? Since Ms Șerban reports to Anca, could you check if Anca reports to Ms Șerban? Is it the case that the analytics pipeline doesn't depend on the VPN gateway? The Passport Office in Porto issues a building permit, correct? Please find out who checked out Soups of Transylvania. When exactly did Fatima look after the VPN gateway? Fuel drums remain locked. What were the dates when Roxana taught German? Not counting Victor Gheorghiu, please find out who flies to Valencia. In what period did Alejandro teach computer science? The recycling truck missed Canal Road on three consecutive Mondays. Do you know if Amira Nasser goes to Wagner Primary School? Is it the case that Veaceslav reports to Mr Rădulescu? Fact-check: Omar doesn't treat Fatima Haddad. Where does Oksana live? Olena Melnyk travels to Ploiești? The channel marker shifted. How old is Tariq? I need to know if Attila was responsible for the inventory API on 1 February 2020. Is there anyone at Stan & Partners who works there but does not live in Porto? In what period was Brândușa based in Bistrița? Which doctors treat someone who is allergic to lactose? Amin replaced the hinge and Bela tightened the latch but the hatch still rattles.

message: Can you confirm that Małgorzata is the owner of the plot of land by the river? Is there somebody at Greenline Transport who works there and lives in Sighișoara? Is it true that João is certified? Besides João, I'd like to know who takes part in the town hall debate. Honestly, should Jun accept the offer from Orion Robotics or not? Please find out which book Jonas Becker writes. How often was the jazz evening postponed? If I pay in person, can Jürgen Schmidt collect the certificate? Alina put the receipt under the bright road label. I'd like to know who is based in Bacău. In what period did Kavya live in Kraków? Is Meera allowed to sign a work permit? Leena counted the flares. Not counting Olivia, please find out who treats Emma. Valentina Navarro is the doctor of Eleni. In what period did Mr Lazăr own the old sailing boat? The Tulcea Dental Practice is based in Suceava? The brass teacher wants the students to listen before playing. True or false: Andreea is enrolled at Ploiești Technical College. How many times was the Tuesday board meeting postponed? Up to what date was Agnieszka Nowak enrolled at Tóth Primary School? Since Zoltán is on the Orhei Falcons, could you check if Hao Li plays for the Orhei Falcons? Does Radu still live in Thessaloniki? The pump failed overnight. Is it the case that Carpathia Energy published The Salt Road? Which people work at which companies in Lagos? How long did Hao play for Rapid Focșani? I don't work at Hughes & Partners, but does my brother work at Hughes & Partners? Tell me whether Brightfield Foods published The Glass Orchard. Where does Roxana live, Lyon, right? Can you tell me who studies at Ploiești Technical College? The fare changed because the driver crossed the toll bridge.

message: Bela scratched the kitchen mat. Is it true that Karim attended the chess tournament? Fact-check: Ayşe looks after the analytics pipeline. Which coach trains the team that Tamás is on? Which wheel rubs the fender? Hypothetically, if Ms Eze teaches German, can you check whether Haruka teaches German? Can you check whether Mei Liu visits Lyon? Which people are employed by a firm based in Lviv? Not counting Ildikó Farkas, please find out who is allergic to lactose. Did Arin find the taxi stand? The bins are full and the lids are loose and the pavement is blocked. Where is Yusuf's pickup pin? Fact-check: Alexandru does not train the Brașov Falcons. Is it true that Sophie does not attend the wedding reception? Where did Dan store the pump? Is it the case that the mail server depends on the VPN gateway? Is Emma still playing for Kraków United? Apart from Mr Tóth, how many people work at Brightfield Foods? I was wondering whether Sânziana Voicu is certified. How many times was the product launch postponed? Who works at a company in Buzău? When exactly did Jun report to Zoltán Varga? I need to know if Ruxandra raises Ananya. Is Kavya allowed to sign a residence certificate? Remind me when the bakery on the corner belonged to Jack. The bakery on the corner belongs to Mircea, and the flat on Mihai Viteazu Street belongs to Ioana. Alexandria Children's Clinic is located in Craiova. Fact-check: Nils Nilsen is the chef at the Community Centre on Elm Street. Will the drain, before the rain starts, be cleared beside the station? Does Raluca manage anyone who lives in Călărași? Since Daria Stan is a parent of Sofía, is it true that Greenline Transport employs Daria Stan? Other than Vikram, tell me who checked out A Short History of Bridges.

message: Do you know who manages Iurie? Honestly, should Corina accept the offer from Greenline Transport or not? Not counting Joaquín, please find out who trains the Botoșani Falcons. Is it the case that Zsófia Tóth is allergic to dust mites? The boatyard has three empty cradles near the south fence. Is it true that Minh is trained? I was wondering whether The Last Ferry was written by Valentina. Fact-check: Paloma goes to Țurcanu Primary School. Honestly, did Oluwaseun work under Jessica on 1 April 2020? Mei Lin requested the history volume yesterday. The harbor gate is shut. Which inspection form did Kiran leave with the dockmaster yesterday? Apart from Kenji, how many people work at Popescu & Partners? Ailin packed the flares and Farid counted the vests and both returned to the launch. Could the mechanic call Radu when the filter arrives? Since Ms Li treats Aiko Sato, is it true that Atelier Kovács employs Ms Li? Where does the person who manages Paula Rădulescu live? How often did Julien take part in the charity run? Will the drain, before the rain starts, be cleared beside the station? Just checking: is Tatiana the author of The Glass Orchard? Why was my invoice revised? The pump failed overnight. Please find out who checked out Soups of Transylvania. In what period did Kavya live in Kraków? In what period was Ghiță based in Cluj-Napoca? Can you tell me who studies at Ploiești Technical College? Please tell Ema whether the daily rate includes unlimited mileage. How many times was the Tuesday board meeting postponed? The engine is cold even after the short drive. Unless the charger arrives tomorrow, Idris cannot test the socket. Where does Roxana live, Lyon, right? Since Nuria landed early, the driver is waiting at arrivals.

ask the crew to clear the leaves before the storm.

why did Thảo Phạm resign?
Who works at Carpathia Energy and is over 40 years old?
Oana is on the Pune Falcons.
find out who borrows Soups of Transylvania.
Since the login service is down, could you check what brought down the login service?
How many companies publish The Clockmaker's Daughter?
which book does Tisa Textiles publish?

Where does Mehmet live, Busan       ?
The Passport Office in Porto issues a building permit         ?

message: Radu measured the fork twice. Do you know if Hao treats Iurie? Is it true that Mr Phạm owns the vineyard near Sibiu? Does Katalin need an appointment? Not counting Élodie, please find out who lives in Galați. The notice says the records counter closes at four. Is it the case that Bogdan-Ionuț Rădulescu reports to Veaceslav Rotaru? Radu waits by the fountain. I need to know who borrows Winter in Maramureș. Fact-check: a birth certificate is not issued by the Bistrița Land Office. How long was Kostas married to Florin? Is it true that not all players of the Reșița Falcons are certified? If I pay in person, can Jürgen Schmidt collect the certificate? Please find out where Andrei is based. How often was the jazz evening postponed? Is Petru still playing for Izmir United? Does Hao Li manage anyone who lives in Buzău? Mădălina is the author of Letters to a Young Engineer? Is Camille still employed by Carpathia Energy? Since Atelier Brown published Soups of Transylvania, could you check if Nordwind Systems published Soups of Transylvania? Faris will inspect the rescue rings after the morning tide falls. Hana replaced the damp blankets in the rescue boat. Amin replaced the hinge and Bela tightened the latch but the hatch still rattles. Which fee applies if Nneka Okafor submits the online form? Is there anyone at Wagner & Partners who works there but does not live in Orhei? In what period did Fatima Mansour look after the VPN gateway? Fact-check: Aiko Tanaka does not treat Mehmet. Will my application, if the inspector approves the drawing, move to the payment desk? When exactly did Sophie Bennett go to Lazăr Primary School? Are all the students at the Kraków Language School trained? I don't work at Stan & Partners, but does my brother work at Stan & Partners? I wonder where Harry is based.

I wonder if Delta Print carries bicycle parts. Is it true that the VPN gateway depends on the mail server? Is it the case that Orion Robotics employs Ana? Honestly, does the search index not depend on the backup cluster? Does Wojciech Nowak still work at Nordwind Systems? Apart from Elif, how many people work at Atelier Lazăr? What about Jun? How does Manon pay, any idea? In what period did Brândușa live in Bistrița? Anca is the author of The Glass Orchard, right? Up to what date was Agnieszka Nowak enrolled at Tóth Primary School? Does Florin manage anyone who lives in Porto? Out of curiosity, why is Viorel ill? When did Emre start to maintain the booking app? Who works at a company in Pune? Fact-check: Tunde does not reside in Timișoara. Which pier serves the launch? Please find out who treats Botond. Orhei Children's Clinic is located in Bistrița. The recycling truck missed Canal Road on three consecutive Mondays. The channel marker shifted. Which streetlight is broken? Which coach trains the team that Nour Khalil is on? Tell me whether Brightfield Foods published The Glass Orchard. Why exactly is the inventory API out of service? If the car is damaged, does the deposit cover the repair? Fact-check: Nordwind Systems does not carry school uniforms. Is Oak Lane flooded?

message: Fact-check: Vertex Analytics carries school uniforms. Do you know if Mr Lefèvre flies to Craiova? Is it correct that The Glass Orchard was written by Ms Dobre? Can Kofi collect the fare? Nour asked whether the rental desk closes on Sunday. Not counting Élodie, please find out who lives in Galați. How old is Viorica? Which people are employed by a firm based in Zalău? Is it the case that Veaceslav reports to Mr Rădulescu? No skiffs left yesterday. Fact-check: Teodora does not play for CS Bistrița. When exactly did Atelier Stan employ Silviu? Where is Yusuf's pickup pin? I'd like to know who is based in Bacău. Will the night bus stop beside the public library? In what period was Andreea based in Galați? Is Alexandru Voicu allowed to sign a passport? In what period did Veaceslav Cebotari go to Lisbon Technical College? How many offices issue a tax clearance certificate? Can you confirm that Jun Zhao does not have an allergy to latex? The buffet starts when Farah arrives. Who actually made The Salt Road? How does Oliver get to work? I wonder where Radu is based. In what period did Mr Lazăr own the old sailing boat? Who works at a company in Arad? When exactly did Amira go to Craiova Arts High School? Eira locked the locker and Halim took the key and the night crew signed the log. Which wheel rubs the fender? How long was Minh based in Galați? Please find out where Silviu lives. Please tell the lighting crew that Birch Square remains dark.

When exactly did Csaba look after the analytics pipeline? Since Roxana is allergic to pollen, is it true that Petronela Anghel is allergic to pollen? Where did Dan store the pump? message: Do you know how many times the code review session was postponed? Mira holds the spare painter. Is it true that the billing service relies on the reporting dashboard? Should Irina accept the offer from Vertex Analytics? Who works at a company in Kraków? I wonder if Oliver is the doctor of Wanjiru Kariuki. Is it the case that Bohdan is a child of Ion? Emeka lives in Alba Iulia. In what period did Mei look after the login service? Does Hugo still work at Nordwind Systems? Not counting Chloé, please find out who is based in Lyon. I'm trying to find out who works for Brightfield Foods. Since Zoltán is on the Orhei Falcons, could you check if Hao Li plays for the Orhei Falcons? I wonder how Min-jun goes to work. Since Ngozi flies to Izmir, and Răzvan flies to Izmir, could you check if Bohdan does not fly to Izmir? When does rubbish collection start? Is the east berth vacant? Besides Radu Ungureanu, could you check who is the coach of Olimpia Sibiu? Oana is on the Pune Falcons. Given that the Târgu Mureș Town Hall issues a work permit, is it correct that a work permit is issued by the Tampere Town Hall? The launch crew saw foam beside the breakwater at sunrise. Which desk did Akiko go to? Fact-check: Iancu doesn't train Bistrița United. Is it the case that Csaba doesn't train Rapid Zalău? Did Zakaria tighten the stern line before the rain began? Fact-check: a birth certificate is not issued by the Bistrița Land Office. Is Meera allowed to sign a work permit? Which inspection form did Kiran leave with the dockmaster yesterday? Which coach trains the team that Tamás is on? How old is Zeynep? Is Oak Lane flooded? I don't work at Greenline Transport, but does my brother work at Greenline Transport?

message: Jürgen Schmidt replaced only the front wipers. Do you know how many times the booking app was out of service? Did Mei grease the headset? Is it true that the Craiova Town Hall issues a birth certificate? In what period did Matei Voicu go to Ardeleanu Primary School? Is it the case that Bogdan-Ionuț Rădulescu reports to Veaceslav Rotaru? Not counting Minh, please find out who goes to Neagu Primary School. Honestly, did Oluwaseun work under Jessica on 1 April 2020? I was wondering whether Katrin is based in Nairobi. Who works at a company in Bălți? The tide turns at noon. Where did Dan store the pump? Since Roxana is allergic to pollen, is it true that Petronela Anghel is allergic to pollen? Which streetlight is broken? I'd like to know who is based in Bacău. How often did Julien take part in the charity run? Which coach trains the team that James is on? Does Hassan manage anyone who lives in Pitești? How many people study at Szeged Music Academy? Apart from Mr Tóth, how many people work at Brightfield Foods? Unless the charger arrives tomorrow, Idris cannot test the socket. True or false: Andreea is enrolled at Ploiești Technical College. Since Tudor reports to Mehmet, do you know if Mehmet reports to Tudor? Anke Weber booked the rehearsal room for Thursday evening. Is Enikő older than Mr Constantinescu? Which wheel rubs the fender? How many venues host the regional chess tournament? Do you know if Grace does not borrow The Salt Road? Are the copies certified? How often was the jazz evening postponed? Who actually made The Salt Road? I think the encore sounds better without the shaker.

message: Oksana Shevchenko is based in Szeged, correct? I think the encore sounds better without the shaker. Could you check if Sigrid has an allergy to lactose? How about Mr Hughes? Not counting Olivia, please find out who treats Emma. Chinedu is a child of Grace. Is it the case that Thomas Walker is a child of Thảo? Until what date did Ghiță go to the Valencia Language School? Orion Robotics employs Nikos Georgiou. Why was my invoice revised? How often was the spring book fair postponed? Honestly, should Sigrid accept the offer from Delta Print or not? Does Hiroshi Sato manage anyone who lives in Botoșani? Which fee applies if Nneka Okafor submits the online form? Which gate serves Leila's flight? Is Octavian allowed to sign a driving licence? I'm trying to find out who works for Brightfield Foods. If I pay in person, can Jürgen Schmidt collect the certificate? Is it true that Mr Nistor reports to Nour? In what period did Daniel train CS Bacău? Can I, since the letter arrived late, submit the evidence tomorrow? Fact-check: Iancu doesn't train Bistrița United. How does Oliver get to work? Does Tudor still live in Buzău? The display is still blank. Which people are employed by a firm based in Lviv? Which desk did Akiko go to? When does the reading club meet? Which coach trains the team that Nour Khalil is on? Who works at a company in Cluj-Napoca? The driver says Gabriel's flight will land after midnight. Can I collect my car before the garage closes? Besides Larisa, tell me who works for Orion Robotics. Besides Constantin Florea, I'd like to know who is married to Kaveh. Since Iulia is a child of Élodie Girard, do you know if Élodie Girard is a child of Iulia? Is the bridge toll separate from the quoted fare? Layla is a parent of Ms Țurcanu, correct? When exactly did Aditya go to Piatra Neamț Arts High School? The bakery on the corner belongs to Mircea, and the flat on Mihai Viteazu Street belongs to Ioana. Remind me when the bakery on the corner belonged to Jack. In what period was Andreea based in Galați? Since Blue Harbor Media published Letters to a Young Engineer, is it the case that it published Letters to a Young Engineer? What were the dates when João maintained the billing service? Is the clinic open after the grooming class ends on Saturday? Can Jo collect the repaired scooter at 10? Does anyone working at Greenline Transport live in Piatra Neamț? Quick question: is Medeea enrolled at Vaslui Music Academy? Are all the students at the Kraków Language School trained?

message: Should Irina accept the offer from Vertex Analytics? Do you know how many times the booking app was out of service? Is it correct that The Glass Orchard was written by Ms Dobre? Leena counted the flares. Is it the case that Veaceslav reports to Mr Rădulescu? Ana-Maria will bring the updated chart to the morning briefing. When exactly did Sophie Bennett go to Lazăr Primary School? I need to know where Ilinca is based. Not counting Luminița, please find out who has an allergy to lactose. Should Anna-Lena accept the offer from Vertex Analytics?
Does Lucía still work at Nordwind Systems?
Mira holds the spare painter.
Is it true that João is certified?
Not counting Ildikó Farkas,        find out who is allergic to lactose.
Paloma goes to Țurcanu Primary School.
Is it the case that Greenline Transport employed Mr Li on 1 July 2023?
I'm trying to find out who is married to Paula Oprea.
Can I, since the letter arrived late, submit the evidence tomorrow?
Is it true that not all players of the Slatina Falcons are certified?
find out who treats Botond.
Who works at Orion Robotics and is over 50 years old?
The novel is overdue by two days.
The display is still blank.
When exactly did Simona play for CS Piatra Neamț?
Can I collect my car before the garage closes?
Is the pavement icy?
Can you tell me where Hassan is based?
How long did Greenline Transport employ Alejandro?
In what period did Mehmet report to Alexandru Căpraru?
Which coach trains the team that Ovidiu is on?
Is the terrace open for lunch on Tuesday?
Who signed the certificate?
Fuel drums remain locked.
Amin replaced the hinge and Bela tightened the latch but the hatch still rattles.
How long was Minh based in Galați?
Since the login service is down, could you check what brought down the login service?
In what period did Daniel train CS Bacău?
does Blue Harbor Media not sell second-hand laptops?
is Jack Smith the doctor of Oana?
Up to what date was Agnieszka Nowak enrolled at Tóth Primary School?
Alina put the receipt under the bright road label.
Are the copies certified?
Who works at a company in Kraków?
The fare changed because the driver crossed the toll bridge.
Does Iulia Stan manage anyone who lives in Timișoara?
Which people work at which companies in Lagos?
The bakery on the corner belongs to Mircea, and the flat on Mihai Viteazu Street belongs to Ioana.
Is there anyone at Wagner & Partners who works there but does not live in Orhei?
Since Mehmet is a child of Alejandro, is it the case that Alejandro is a child of Mehmet?
I don't work at Tóth & Partners, but does my sister work at Tóth & Partners?
Where does Aiko live, Busan       ?
Esmeralda is not the spouse of James.
Andreea is enrolled at Ploiești Technical College.
Has the bus shelter reopened?
Where is the atlas of coastal towns kept?

message: Emre Yılmaz found the lost pick. Do you know if the Riverside Medical Centre in Vaslui employs Ghiță? Going by what was known on 25 July 2023, is it true that Kaveh went to Varga Primary School on March 14, 2024? Did Mei grease the headset? Nour asked whether the rental desk closes on Sunday. Not counting Minh, please find out who goes to Neagu Primary School. Is it the case that Vertex Analytics stocks LED bulbs? Who works at a company in Buzău? Did 4 rental bikes arrive before September 12? I don't work at Neagu & Partners, but does my sister work at Neagu & Partners? The tide turns at noon. Since Atelier Brown published Soups of Transylvania, could you check if Nordwind Systems published Soups of Transylvania? At what time will Dan arrive at the pickup point? Are all the students at the Cahul Language School trained? Nadia wants the tasting menu without the wine pairing. Where does the person who manages Paula Rădulescu live? Where does Oksana live? I need to know which company sells winter tyres. Which property that Layla Mansour owns costs the most? Please find out who flies to Cahul. Is there anyone at Stan & Partners who works there but does not live in Porto? Did most drivers find the pickup point by dusk? Please find out where Grace lives. How long did Paloma look after the login service? Is it true that not all players of Izmir United are certified? The pump failed overnight. Would the crew, when the road reopens, collect the bins from the closed end? Under what part did Hadi find the loose screw? Is it the case that Csaba doesn't train Rapid Zalău? Could you check if Grace doesn't borrow The Salt Road? Amira did not write Soups of Transylvania. When exactly did Aditya go to Piatra Neamț Arts High School? The adoption fair is indoors if the weather turns bad. Is Meera allowed to sign a work permit? Apart from Kenji, how many people work at Popescu & Partners? Nadia booked the van and collected the keys and returned the old permit. The harbor gate is shut. I wonder if Marius plans to relocate to Târgu Mureș. Please tell Ema whether the daily rate includes unlimited mileage. When exactly was Silviu Toma the spouse of Kavya? Unless the charger arrives tomorrow, Idris cannot test the socket. Fact-check: Tunde does not intend to attend the parents' evening. Ayşe is married to Achieng Odhiambo; Mădălina is married to Xiaoling. Is the pavement icy? Is Camille still employed by Carpathia Energy? I wonder how Katrin goes to work. The vet did not promise that the results would arrive today. Please find out which book Jonas Becker writes.
